title: AshCraftX
description: The name of the mod comes from my name, it has nothing to do with real ash :)
body:
The name of the mod comes from my name, it has nothing to do with real ash :)
In the mod there are 2 new Gem, one of them is obtaniable and the other is craftable

Think of these as 2 tiers, Ailish and Eilish

Eilish tool and weapons are more powerful than netherite and others. They are more useful both statistically and effectually.

A new combination item type is being added to the game. This type is called Bax. It functions as a combination of a pickaxe, an axe, and a shovel. When you hold Eilish Bax in your hand, you will gain the Haste 2 effect. It also has a very high speed, making it faster than all other tools in the normal game. There is also a Eilish sword. When you hold this sword, you gain the Speed 1 and Strength 2 effects, and since its damage is already quite high, you can even kill an iron golem in three hits.
